exposure: International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria
75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) value ≥ 153 mg/dL at 2 h
75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) value ≥ 180 mg/dL at 1 h
cohort: 67 singleton pregnancies with false-positive early GDM and 1774 singleton pregnancies with normal glucose tolerance (NGT) who delivered after 22 weeks of gestation
finding: There were no clinically significant differences in pregnancy outcomes between women with false-positive early GDM and women with NGT, except for a higher neonatal hypoglycemia rate in the false-positive early GDM group.
